findings.problem: Long valid Node roster labels leave their native card allocation at 390px.
findings.evidence: 8/8 title ranges clipped in both 390px cases after individual native scrolling; desktop and selected-scale tablet title ranges fit.
findings.proposal: Attach an app-owned scope to the existing roster grid/cards; bound card/header/action min-widths and wrap the complete native label. Preserve exact labels, host IDs and View bindings.

findings.problem: Node detail title, trust rows, nested grants and metadata extend beyond the native modal reading allocation.
findings.evidence: Detail title and four long trust values clip in all four cases; long Run as clips at 390px/selected 2x, grant prose at selected 2x. Exact metadata bytes are retained, but focused-dialog End leaves its final range outside the clip in both phone cases and selected-scale tablet.
findings.proposal: Use app-owned types on existing noninteractive detail/body/trust/grant graph containers. Bound header/body/footer width and scroll allocation; allow complete identifiers/prose and the existing exact reader to wrap within it. Keep all operator controls, modal lifecycle, validation, grants and calls unchanged.

findings.problem: Kubernetes Node cards overflow the existing responsive grid.
findings.evidence: At 390px the grid is already one column but 308px allocation has 446px scroll width and all six long headings clip; selected 2x tablet keeps two 335px columns with 797px scroll width across a 686px allocation.
findings.proposal: Scope the existing Kubernetes inventory grid and native card/header/actions for app-owned width-aware columns, shrinking and wrapping. Preserve labels, UIDs, Select availability and local exact binding.

findings.problem: Kubernetes technical description labels and values cannot be read within the selected-scale tablet cards.
findings.evidence: 74 source-bounded summary rows were measured individually; selected 2x tablet clips labels and values despite native scrolling. Exact record text and its measured final range remain available; tall records requiring vertical scrolling are not classified as failures.
findings.proposal: Scope the existing Technical details description list for app-owned label/value allocation, wrapping and responsive stacking inside the card. Retain the 64-quantity summary cap, omission notice, exact raw strings and complete bounded JSON.
